Mozilla PDF.js (pdfjs-dist) 5.6.205, Apache-2.0. Bundled from the installed runtime package. Upstream: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js . LICENSE is included. The upstream pdf.min.mjs and pdf.worker.min.mjs files are named .js here so the existing local static server supplies the JavaScript MIME type. They remain ES modules. No other code changes. No remote PDF services are used.
